instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 100 words) about a time you had to choose a method to solve a problem. Use a topic sentence and at least two supporting sentences. Include one sentence with although or while, and one with because or because of.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
